newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: SBC to close Bahrain OBU branch.
newsitem.headline: SBC to close Bahrain OBU branch.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corporation (SBC) plans to close its offshore banking unit (OBU) in Bahrain, the Gulf's main financial and banking centre, at the end of this year, banking sources said on Wednesday.
"A decision has been taken to close the OBU branch on December 31," one said. He declined to give further details or give the reasons behind the closure.

The bankers said SBC would maintain its representative office on the island. Other than Bahrain, SBC has two other Gulf representative offices, one in Dubai -- which opened this month -- and another in Abu Dhabi.
"The bank's operation will continue (in Bahrain) through the existence of its representative office," one banker said.
There were 48 OBUs operating in Bahrain at the end of 1995.
OBUs total assets fell to $61.50 billion in the first half of 1996 from $67.98 billion a year earlier, according to figures issued by the Bahrain Monetary Agency last month.
